name: vibe-read
description: Read your AI's code like a book. Save it as notes.

Vibe Read: Read as a page
Vibe Read: Open a sample file

vibe-read-resting.description: Vibe Read, resting — the code and the reasoning still mixed together

vibe-read-reading.description: Vibe Read, reading — the code gone, the reasoning left

vibe-read-notes.description: Keep it as notes — a page in the same weight as the faces, because a line-drawn codicon beside them read as another set

vibe-read-reset.description: Puts all the vibes back — the arrow only; the word beside it belongs to the row, where a label can actually be clicked

walkthroughs.title: Read the why
walkthroughs.description: Your AI explains its code in comments. Two clicks to read them.

steps.title: Open a file your AI wrote
steps.description:
Any code file with comments in it.
[Open a sample file](command:vibeRead.openSample)

steps.title: Click 📖 Read
steps.description: At the bottom right, or press Alt+X. Every reason in the file, numbered on one calm page. Save it as notes if you want to keep it.

steps.title: Or hide the code right in the editor
steps.description: Click Hide, or press Alt+M. The code hides, the reasons stay in place. Select a few lines first to hide only those.

vibeRead.mark.markdownDescription:
Your vibe — what you see wherever the code is hidden, and the one shown in the status bar. A duck and a cup by default; pick another from the status bar, or type your own.

Easier to change from the status bar than from here.

vibeRead.marks.markdownDescription:
The slots offered when you click your vibe in the status bar. Their names — Duck, Quiet, Shh, Oops, Wise — belong to the slots, so putting something else in the Shh slot still leaves it your Shh.

Easier to change there than here: the pencil on each row opens your system's emoji keyboard. Delete this setting to get these back.

vibeRead.showEditorButton.description: Show the reading button above the editor while the code is hidden. Reading also has 📖 Read in the status bar and Alt+X.
